title: Search for a metal tablet given to a boy by aliens

tellings.quote:
Here in Sweden, we have
been up in the north. Uh there was a guy
who said that he was a a young boy.

plain: In northern Sweden, a man said that when he was a young boy, aliens gave him a metal tablet, and researchers went up north to search for it. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells Michels about the man's claim and the search, and if such a tablet were found it would be a physical object from an encounter.
